workout.warmup: Walk to the gym, THEN ramp up the Smith squat: empty bar x8, then 2 progressively heavier warmup sets. On lower day this doubles as your back warmup  do NOT skip it, especially with the mid-back tweak.
workout.finisher: Walk home. Optional 12-15 min incline walk if you want extra cals before the weekend off.
workout.coach_note: LOWER  Strength Block Day 7, then OFF Sat-Sun (just rest, the block continues Mon/Tue). BIG FLAG: you tweaked your left mid-back on Wednesday's bench, same spot as your old rhomboid strain. That reorders today  Seated Leg Curl LEADS the hamstring work (it's back-safe), and the Smith RDL is CONDITIONAL: only if the back is 100% warm and pain-free, held at 185 (no increase this week), and you stop at the first sign of tightness. Warm the back up thoroughly before squatting. Everything else, autoregulate like normal  match your numbers, keep reps clean, no ugly grinds.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat [HEAVY]
exercises.note: MAIN LIFT. Last time you worked 205 for 5 and 185 for 6 with good depth. Work at 195-205 today, chase a clean 6 on all sets, below parallel like last time. Hold this range to lock it in before adding  it's a still-new movement.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.note: PRIMARY hamstring today, moved up front because it's back-safe (no spinal load). This got skipped your last two lowers because the machines were taken  grab it early today. Hamstrings are your weak link: controlled tempo, squeeze the contraction, no yanking.

exercises.name: Smith Machine RDL [HEAVY  CONDITIONAL]
exercises.detail: 185 lb w/ straps  4 x 6  HOLD weight (no increase)
exercises.note: BACK CHECK FIRST. Only do these if your left mid-back is 100% warm and pain-free after squats. HOLD at 185 this week  do not add weight. Straps on, drive with hips and hamstrings, bar stays close, neutral spine, soft knees. ANY tightness in that mid-back = stop and skip the rest of the sets; we'll bring the RDL back next lower day once it's fully clear. The leg curl already covered your hamstrings, so skipping this is totally fine today.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.note: You got 12/10/10 last time. Chase a full 12 on all three sets today  once you own that, we bump to 75.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (DB)
exercises.note: Glute + single-leg work to finish. Knee drive at the top, drive through the heel of the working leg. Skip if the session's running long or the back's fussy  it's the optional one today.

exercises.name: Core Circuit (fresh, back-safe)  2 rounds
exercises.detail: Hanging Knee Raise x12  Side Plank 45s/side  Dead Bugs x10/side
exercises.note: Fresh combo, all back-safe given the mid-back. Your abs should be recovered from Monday now. Controlled reps, brace, no straining.
